meta.purpose: Websites discovered by agent-assisted web search on 2026-08-29, for teams whose upstream API carried none. Curated research input for sprint 013 — NOT pipeline output.
meta.method: Three parallel search agents over the 225 teams lacking a website. Each candidate required two independent signals (team number in host/path, nickname in title/host, number adjacent to FTC/FRC in body, or school named as that team's site) AND a successful fetch. Aggregators, social platforms, school generic homepages, and umbrella multi-team org sites were rejected.
meta.reverified: All 31 URLs re-fetched independently by the team-lead on 2026-08-29; all returned HTTP 200.
meta.coverage: 223 of 225 teams searched. ftc-23676 and ftc-32210 were not reached before the search budget ran out.
meta.fll_note: FLL sampled and confirmed to have no websites, matching the prior 0-of-48 hand-curation. Not exhaustively searched.
caveats: Three entries are marked confidence=weak with reasons — treat as unverified until a live fetch confirms.
carlsbaded.org and sites.google.com each host more than one team at DISTINCT paths. Uniqueness must be checked on host+path, not host alone.
Several accepted sites belong to teams FIRST now lists as inactive; content may be several seasons stale.
